_README: This file tracks ingredients that don't match any category. To fix: open docs/ingredient_categories.json and add the ingredient name (or a keyword from it) to the appropriate category array.

_INSTRUCTIONS.step_1: Review the 'items' list below - these ingredients show up in 'Other' category on your site
_INSTRUCTIONS.step_3: For each ingredient, add a relevant keyword to the appropriate category (produce, meat, dairy, bakery, dry_goods, condiments, or spices)
_INSTRUCTIONS.step_4: Example: For 'Sweet Chili Lime Sauce', add 'chili lime sauce' to the 'condiments' array
_INSTRUCTIONS.step_5: Commit the changes to ingredient_categories.json - this report will auto-update next week
